login.title: Meal Coupon Management System
login.subtitle: Enterprise Voucher Management System
login.error: Invalid email or security password provided.

dashboard.systemInfoBody: This is the management dashboard for the Meal Coupon Management System. Your privilege level grants access to features shown in the sidebar.
dashboard.protocolAdmin: As an administrator, all database log alterations are recorded. Perform core data migrations using standard commands.
dashboard.protocolManager: Managers can allocate digital coupons to beneficiaries, edit menu pricing models, and examine overall ticket activities.
dashboard.protocolCafe: Open the Cafe Scanner, scan employee QR cards, and record meals. Unused days this week can be recorded together in one visit.
dashboard.protocolEmployee: Present your QR card at the campus canteen to claim your meal coupon.

users.title: User Directory & RBAC
users.subtitle: Login accounts only — Admin, HR, Finance, and cafe staff. Employees are on the Employees page; they use a QR card, not a password.
users.name: User Name
users.resetHelp: Tell {{name}} ({{email}}) the new password in person. There is no email reset.
users.resetSuccess: Password updated for {{name}}. Give it to them in person.

employees.title: HR Employee Directory
employees.subtitle: Register employees and print QR meal cards
employees.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or employee ID
employees.qrAutoNote: A QR card is created automatically. Employee ID can be left blank to auto-assign.
employees.noQr: No active QR card. Generate one first.
employees.reprintConfirm: This prints a new QR for {{name}} and blocks the old card. Continue?
employees.leaveSectionHelp: Leave dates follow the selected calendar. Leave starts on the first day and ends before the return date. Weekends and registered holidays are off days, so they are not counted in leave days.
employees.leaveIncomplete: Please fill leave days, start date, and return date together.
employees.leaveDaysInvalid: Leave days must be a positive number.
employees.leaveStartInvalid: Please enter a valid leave start date.
employees.leaveReturnInvalid: Please enter a valid return date.
employees.bulkPrintEmpty: No active QR cards to print.
employees.bulkPrintFailed: Could not load cards for printing.
employees.importDescription: Only Full Name is required. Employee ID is optional — the system assigns one if you leave it blank.
employees.selectFile: Click to select an Excel or CSV file
employees.importFailed: Import failed. Please check your file and try again.
employees.importEmpty: No valid employee rows found in the file.
employees.importAllFailed: No employees were imported. See errors below.
employees.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete {{name}}? This cannot be undone.

cafe.title: Cafe scan desk
cafe.subtitle: Scan the employee QR card. Unused days this week can be recorded together in one visit — they do not have to wait until Friday.
cafe.readyBody: Point the camera at the employee QR card.
cafe.overridePlaceholder: State reason for recording after today's claim...
cafe.claimedContactAdmin: Employee already claimed today. Contact an admin for override.
cafe.noMealsToday: No unused meals to record today.
cafe.dailyCapLabel: Day {{day}} of 5 — unused days can be used today (up to {{cap}})
cafe.weekResetNotice: Weekly reset — unused days from last week were voided
cafe.cameraStartFailed: Failed to start camera. Is it in use by another app?
cafe.httpsRequired: Camera is blocked on HTTP. On your phone open https://{{host}}:{{port}} (not http), allow camera access, and accept the security warning for the dev certificate.
cafe.campusMissing: This cafe login is not assigned to a campus. Ask Admin to set the campus on the user account, and ask HR to assign the current vendor under Cafes.

audit.title: Compliance & Security Audit Trail
audit.subtitle: Immutable database-driven ledger tracking system mutations

qrCard.title: Official Employee QR ID Card
qrCard.bulkHelp: Preview is the first card. Print and A4 PDF place 10 cards on each landscape A4 page. CR80 PDF is one plastic-size card per page. Do not generate a new QR for a plastic reprint.
qrCard.exportFailed: Could not prepare the ID cards.
qrCard.popupBlocked: Allow pop-ups to print the cards.

reports.title: Coupon Scan Reports
reports.subtitle: Review scanned coupon counts and Birr totals by day, week, and month.
reports.paymentByCafeHelp: Vouchers used at each campus, billed at 40 birr each. HR can download an editable Word payment order for Finance.
reports.letterFailed: Could not generate the payment letter.
reports.letterHelp: This does not pay the cafe. It fills an editable Word payment order for Finance from the dates and cafe you select.
reports.letterNeedScans: No cafe scans in this date range. Choose last week, last month, or a custom range that has scans, then download the letter.
reports.cafePaymentHelp: Only scans at your campus. Finance pays this vendor for the selected dates.

cafes.title: Campuses and cafe vendors
cafes.subtitle: A campus is the place. A vendor is the company that currently runs that cafe. Employees are one college list either way.
cafes.campusHelp: Add each college location. Cafe staff can only scan at the campus on their account.
cafes.vendorHelp: External operators. Replacing a vendor does not delete past payment records.
cafes.assigned: Vendor assigned. New scans will be billed to this operator.

offDays.title: Off days
offDays.subtitle: Public holidays and any extra closed day. No vouchers are earned or used on these dates.
offDays.invalid: Choose a date and a reason.
